decisive_finding.issue: The public routine manifest action named pass synthesizes a command that writes a node marker and reports behavior_observed=true without checking the declared repository source or requested behavior.
evidence: validator/src/cli/successor_public/routine/manifest.rs maps repository input to Pass and generates self-certifying marker arguments.
validator/src/cli/successor_public/routine.rs executes the generated arguments while only binding source identity around them.
The positive journey asserts the compile marker rather than a real repository behavior, so broken source can still produce a passed public outcome.
decisive_finding.impact: A green public routine result can be fabricated by manifest intent without causal product behavior, violating the false-pass acceptance gate.
decisive_finding.required_fix: Replace self-certifying pass behavior with a deterministic supported real check bound to declared sources, target, candidate, and command; prove broken source causally fails and forged markers or outcomes cannot pass.

verification.result: PASS: 14 passed, but its assertions do not cover the decisive false pass.
